meta.name: Gintama the Movie: The Final Chapter - Be Forever Yorozuya | Gintama Movie: Kanketsu-hen - Yorozuya yo Eien Nare
meta.description: When Gintoki apprehends a movie pirate at a premiere, he checks the camera's footage and finds himself transported to a bleak, post-apocalyptic version of Edo, where a mysterious epidemic called the "White Plague" has ravished the world's population.
